name: CapaEightDTracker
tagline: Run 8D problem solving inside Power Apps – from containment to closure.
description: 8D corrective and preventive action tracker for manufacturing quality teams: D0–D8 disciplines with gated sign-off, IS/IS NOT, containment quantities, 5-Why and fishbone root cause, corrective and preventive actions with overdue tracking, systemic checklist and closure approval – stored as JSON in one column.
features: D0–D8 stepper with live sign-off requirements and sequence enforcement
IS / IS NOT problem description and team roles
Fishbone diagram with verified / suspect / ruled-out causes
Containment, corrective and preventive actions with owners, due dates and overdue flags
Systemic prevention checklist and closure approval
10 outputs plus a DOM event for Power Pages
Phone layouts down to 320 px, keyboard and screen-reader support
